title: Someone Kept Stealing My Lunch at Work 🥪
description:
This story may be inspired by real events or jokes, but all names and details are fictional. Any resemblance to real people is coincidental.

#funny #storytime #office #shorts
style: 3D animated cartoon movie style, expressive characters with big eyes, vibrant colours, cinematic lighting, vertical composition, highly detailed, no text, no letters, no watermark

scenes.text: Every single day, someone stole my lunch from the office fridge. Every. Single. Day.
scenes.image: a tired office worker about 30 with a lanyard and rolled-up sleeves opening an office fridge and finding his lunch box empty, furious

scenes.text: I wrote my name on it in huge letters. Still gone. I put a lock on it. They stole the lock.
scenes.image: a tired office worker about 30 with a lanyard and rolled-up sleeves staring at an empty shelf where a locked lunch box used to be

scenes.text: So I hid a tiny camera inside the lunch bag.
scenes.image: a tired office worker about 30 with a lanyard and rolled-up sleeves secretly placing a tiny camera inside a paper lunch bag

scenes.text: The next day, I checked the footage. And I almost fell off my chair.
scenes.image: a tired office worker about 30 with a lanyard and rolled-up sleeves watching a laptop screen, jaw dropping

scenes.text: It was my boss. The CEO. Eating my sandwich, with his eyes closed, like it was the best thing he ever tasted.
scenes.image: a big bossy manager about 50 with a tie and a coffee mug blissfully eating a sandwich in front of an office fridge, eyes closed, caught on camera

scenes.text: I stormed into his office with the video. He looked at the screen, then at me.
scenes.image: a tired office worker about 30 with a lanyard and rolled-up sleeves holding up a laptop in front of a big bossy manager about 50 with a tie and a coffee mug at his desk

scenes.text: He said, who makes these sandwiches? I said, I do. He said, you're promoted.
scenes.image: a big bossy manager about 50 with a tie and a coffee mug pointing at a tired office worker about 30 with a lanyard and rolled-up sleeves with a big smile, shaking his hand

scenes.text: My new title is head of team lunches. I make sandwiches for forty people now. I miss when he just stole mine.
scenes.image: a tired office worker about 30 with a lanyard and rolled-up sleeves in a chef hat making a mountain of sandwiches in the office kitchen, exhausted
